name: ecommerce-tax-filament
description: Filament 5 operator surface for tax jurisdictions, registrations, rate versions and the append-only quote ledger.
features: Operator surface for jurisdictions, registrations and effective-dated rate versions
Revising a rate creates a successor version; there is no edit-in-place form
Quotes and rate versions are read-only at the resource level, below the policy layer
Every unpublished ability is refused by name, including the relation abilities
Quote evidence is read whole: lines, treatments, reasons and rate applications
Period tax report folded from the quote ledger three independent ways
Rates render as basis points and a decimal string, never as a float
